title: Variational Estimators for Node Popularity Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.17783v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Node popularity is recognized as a key factor in modeling real-world networks, capturing heterogeneity in connectivity across communities. This concept is equally important in bipartite networks, where nodes in different partitions may exhibit varying popularity patterns, motivating models such as the Two-Way Node Popularity Model (TNPM). Existing methods, such as the Two-Stage Divided Cosine (TSDC) algorithm, provide a scalable estimation approach but may have limitations in terms of accuracy or applicability across different types of networks. In this paper, we develop a computationally efficient and theoretically justified variational expectation-maximization (VEM) framework for the TNPM. We establish label consistency for the estimated community assignments produced by the proposed variational estimator in bipartite networks. Through extensive simulation studies, we show that our method achieves superior estimation accuracy

translated_title: 节点流行度模型的变分估计器
translated_abstract: 节点流行度被认为是建模现实世界网络的一个关键因素，它刻画了不同社区之间连接的异质性。这一概念在二部网络中同样重要，其中不同分部中的节点可能表现出不同的流行度模式，由此催生了双向节点流行度模型（TNPM）等模型。现有方法，如两阶段分割余弦（TSDC）算法，提供了可扩展的估计方法，但在估计精度或对不同类型网络的适用性方面可能存在局限。在本文中，我们为TNPM开发了一个计算高效且有理论支撑的变分期望最大化（VEM）框架。我们在二部网络中为所提出的变分估计器产生的社区划分估计建立了标签一致性。通过大量的仿真研究，我们证明了我们的方法能够实现更优的估计精度。
tldr: 本文为双向节点流行度模型（TNPM）开发了一种计算高效且有理论保证的变分期望最大化（VEM）估计框架，在二部网络中证明了社区划分的标签一致性，并实现了优于现有方法的估计精度。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a computationally efficient and theoretically justified variational expectation-maximization (VEM) framework for the Two-Way Node Popularity Model, establishing label consistency for community assignments in bipartite networks and achieving superior estimation accuracy.
